name: 67672 · Wakeeney, KS
findings: ZIP 67672 (Wakeeney) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67672 (Wakeeney) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 67672 (Wakeeney) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
